Easy_1.rationale: Single-step ratio computation with all inputs explicitly given

ModerateEasy_2.rationale: Apply: one-step computation with data selection. Analyze: compute + interpret against single benchmark

Moderate_3.rationale: Analyze: multi-step computation with interpretation. Evaluate: judgment-based selection among competing analytical interpretations

Difficult_4.rationale: Requires professional judgment across multiple analytical frameworks

topics: Operating cash flow ratio computation and interpretation
Free cash flow calculation and analysis
Quality of earnings — cash flow vs. accrual income divergence
Operating cash flow to capital expenditures
Cash flow coverage of fixed charges
Sustainable growth rate link to profitability
EPS quality assessment (basic vs diluted, adjusted)
Liquidity vs. solvency distinction in credit decisions
Off-balance-sheet obligations impact on credit metrics
Cash flow adequacy for debt repayment

prohibited_patterns: No strategic recommendation items (e.g., 'which capital structure should the company adopt?')
No multi-year trend projection requiring compound growth
No items where correct answer requires professional judgment without a single defensible path
No items with >2 numerical calculations required to reach the answer (for Easy through Moderate)
No items that embed authoring notes or scratch work

phase_1.description: Single-step ratio computations with all inputs explicitly given. Cash flow ratios, profitability ratios, credit ratios

phase_2.description: Ratio computation with data selection from a brief scenario. Some items require interpretation against a single benchmark

phase_3.description: Multi-step or comparative analysis. Some items require professional judgment among competing interpretations

phase_4.description: Professional judgment items requiring evaluation across multiple frameworks (but NOT multi-signal integration)
